name: rsi2_etf
description: Connors-style RSI(2) mean reversion on SPY and QQQ, moved here from a sibling project's ledger (deployed settings: threshold 10 with the 200-day filter, exit above the prior 5-day average). Half in each. The original used unadjusted closes and filled at the signal close; this ledger uses dividend-adjusted prices and fills at the next open, so signals near ex-dividend dates can differ slightly and it starts fresh.

expected.source: the sibling project's backtest, calibrated on the last ten years
expected.note: about +0.4% a trade with a 79% win rate; in the market only a few days at a time
